result.instructions: Tools for Robly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which contacts joined my Robly account this week, and which lists are they on?"; "Is jane@example.com subscribed, and which lists is she on?"; "Add john@example.com to the Newsletter list with the first name John.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Robly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run robly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run robly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run robly_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. robly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: robly_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (members) of the Robly account, newest first as Robly orders them: id, email, subscribed/deleted flags, subscription date, sign-up source, timestamps. Filter by status, by list, or by last-updated time; optionally include each contact's lists and data fields. Pages with limit (max 100) and offset: pass next_offset from the previous reply. Robly does not return a total. GET /api/v1/contacts/show.

status.description: Only contacts with this status (default all).

list_id.description: Only contacts on this list (sub list id from robly_list_sub_lists).

updated_since.description: Only contacts changed since this ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

include_sub_lists.description: Include the lists each contact is on.

include_fields.description: Include each contact's data fields (name, custom fields).

tools.name: robly_find_contact
tools.title: Find contact
tools.description: Look up one contact by email address or member id: status, subscription date, sign-up source and, on request, the lists and data fields. Returns found: false when Robly has no such contact. GET /api/v1/contacts/search.

member_id.description: Robly contact (member) id. Give this OR email.

email.description: The contact's email address. Give this OR member_id.

include_sub_lists.description: Include the lists the contact is on.

tools.name: robly_check_list_membership
tools.title: Check list membership
tools.description: Whether one contact (by email or member id) is on one list. GET /api/v1/contacts/exists_in_sub_list.

member_id.description: Robly contact (member) id. Give this OR email.

email.description: The contact's email address. Give this OR member_id.

tools.name: robly_list_sub_lists
tools.title: List sub lists
tools.description: List the account's sub lists (the lists contacts belong to): id, name, position, timestamps. Public lists only unless include_all is true. Use the ids for list filters and for adding contacts. GET /api/v1/sub_lists/show.

tools.name: robly_list_fields
tools.title: List data fields
tools.description: List the contact data fields (First Name, Last Name, custom fields): id, label, type, required flag and the user_tag that robly_subscribe_contact and robly_update_contact use as the field key. GET /api/v1/fields/show.

include_all.description: Also include fields hidden from public sign-up forms.

tools.name: robly_get_signup_form
tools.title: Get sign-up form
tools.description: The data fields and sub lists a new subscriber can be given through the sign-up API (public ones unless include_all is true). GET /api/v1/sign_up/show.

include_all.description: Also include non-public fields and lists.

tools.name: robly_subscribe_contact
tools.title: Subscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a new subscribed contact (or re-submit an existing one through the sign-up form). With double_opt_in Robly EMAILS the contact a confirmation link first; with welcome_email it EMAILS the welcome message right away; with include_autoresponder it triggers matching autoresponders, which email the contact. Only subscribe people who agreed to receive email. Field values go in `fields`, keyed by the user_tag from robly_list_fields (for example fname, lname). POST /api/v1/sign_up/generate.

fields.description: Data field values keyed by user_tag, e.g. {"fname": "Ada", "lname": "Lovelace"}.

sub_list_ids.description: Lists to put the contact on (ids from robly_list_sub_lists).

double_opt_in.description: Send a confirmation email; the contact is subscribed only after clicking it, then gets the welcome email.

welcome_email.description: Skip confirmation and send the welcome email now.

include_autoresponder.description: Trigger matching autoresponders (they email the contact).

tools.name: robly_add_contact_to_list
tools.title: Add contact to list
tools.description: WRITE: put an existing contact on a list. With include_autoresponder Robly triggers autoresponders matching the newly listed contact, which EMAIL the contact. POST /api/v1/contacts/add_sub_list.

member_id.description: Robly contact (member) id. Give this OR email.

email.description: The contact's email address. Give this OR member_id.

include_autoresponder.description: Trigger matching autoresponders (they email the contact).

tools.name: robly_remove_contact_from_list
tools.title: Remove contact from list
tools.description: WRITE: take a contact off one list (the contact itself is kept). POST /api/v1/contacts/remove_sub_list.

member_id.description: Robly contact (member) id. Give this OR email.

email.description: The contact's email address. Give this OR member_id.

tools.name: robly_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing contact's data fields and/or list memberships in one call. Name the contact by member_id (look it up with robly_find_contact). `fields` are keyed by user_tag (robly_list_fields); the email address cannot be changed here. add_to_list_ids puts the contact on those lists, remove_from_list_ids takes it off them. remove_from_all_other_lists also removes the contact from every list NOT named in add_to_list_ids (requires add_to_list_ids). include_autoresponder triggers autoresponders that EMAIL the contact. POST /api/v1/contacts/update_full_contact.

fields.description: Data field values keyed by user_tag, e.g. {"fname": "Ada"}.

add_to_list_ids.description: Lists to put the contact on.

remove_from_list_ids.description: Lists to take the contact off.

remove_from_all_other_lists.description: Also remove the contact from every list not in add_to_list_ids.

include_autoresponder.description: Trigger matching autoresponders (they email the contact).

tools.name: robly_unsubscribe_contact
tools.title: Unsubscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe a contact so Robly stops emailing it. Robly's API cannot undo this: an unsubscribed contact can only come back through a sign-up form. Use it for a contact that asked to stop. POST /api/v1/contacts/unsubscribe.

member_id.description: Robly contact (member) id. Give this OR email.

email.description: The contact's email address. Give this OR member_id.

tools.name: robly_create_sub_list
tools.title: Create sub list
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty sub list. Robly does not say whether a list with the same name already exists, so check robly_list_sub_lists first. POST /api/v1/sub_lists/add_sub_list.

tools.name: robly_rename_sub_list
tools.title: Rename sub list
tools.description: WRITE: rename a sub list. POST /api/v1/sub_lists/rename_sub_list.
